proposals.before: In the twenty-second year of his tenure he died, aged ninety-one; an edict ordered his burial in Wanping county.
proposals.after: In the twenty-second year he died, aged ninety-one; an edict ordered his burial in Wanping county.

proposals.before: When Dazhonglin rebelled, an edict ordered him to pacify the Eastern Capital, with authority to act at his discretion as circumstances required.
proposals.after: When Da Yanlin rebelled, an edict ordered him to pacify the Eastern Capital, with authority to act at his discretion as circumstances required.
proposals.reason: 大延琳 is the personal name Da Yanlin; “Dazhonglin” misreads the name.

decisions.reason: Chinese 二十二年 states only the year; “of his tenure” is not in the source and invents a career-length framing for an era year count.
